member.name: T:JBFramework.KitSettingsBase
member.summary: Base of a mod's ModSettings class. RimWorld finds the settings file by the Mod class name and the settings object by this class's full name, so an existing mod KEEPS both names and only changes the base class: public sealed class LOSettings : KitSettingsBase { }. Settings files stay per mod. File layout: one <kit> node (the template profile: values and section switches), then whatever writes. Legacy migration (one-way): on load, every registration with a legacy field name that the template does not hold yet is read from the old flat node as a string, parsed, clamped and stored; the first time, the old file is copied once to *.xml.pre-kit and every migrated key is logged. Legacy nodes are never written again.
